cl.x: Provide Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2024, Version 01.04).
Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 is a third generation superplasticiser for concrete and mortar. It meets the requirements for high range water reducing superplasticisers according to AS1478.1-2000.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 is especially suitable for concrete mixes with extended transportation times and extended workability requirements, high water reduction and improved flow characteristics. Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 is mainly used for the following applications:
s: Concrete with ultra high water reduction (up to 30%)
High performance concrete
Concrete in hot weather and with extended transportation and workability requirements

cl.l: Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 is a powerful superplasticiser which acts through several different mechanisms including surface adsorption and sterical effects separating the cementitious binder particles. The following advantageous properties are achieved:
s: High water reduction, resulting in high density, high strength and reduced permeability
Superior plasticising effect, resulting in improved flow, placing and compaction characteristics
Reduced shrinkage during curing and reduced creep when hardened
tr: Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 does not contain chlorides or any other ingredients which promote the corrosion of steel. It is therefore suitable for use in reinforced and pre-stressed concrete structures.

s: Composition: Modified polycarboxylates in water
Appearance and colour: Light brownish liquid
Density: Density: 1.07 kg/l (at +20°C) approximately

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Dispensing
cl.x: Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 is added to the gauging water or added with it into the concrete mixer. To take advantage of the high water reduction, a wet mixing time, which is depending on the mixing conditions and mixer performance, of at least 60 seconds per cubic metre after the admixture addition is recommended. Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 shall not be added to dry cement.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Compatibility
cl.x: Sika® ViscoCrete® can be used in conjunction with all the admixtures manufactured by Sika Australia PTY Limited with the exclusion of Sikament ® NN. All admixtures must be added separately. For additional information, please contact Sika technical personnel.

s: When using Sika® ViscoCrete®-10 a suitable mix design has to be taken into account and local material sources shall be trialled.
Do not use with napthalene based admixtures. Excessive water addition or overdosing may cause bleeding or segregation.
